other_conditions: The applicant must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
The applicant must not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS) or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
The applicant must not be an income tax payer.
The applicant must have completed at least 1 year of membership with the Board.
The applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 per month as pension.
